capture.triggerMarker: first frame of the MPD218 pad red LED pulse; six red-channel thresholds independently reproduce 500 pulses
capture.acousticOnset: first sustained 110 Hz slow-motion spectral onset (the 880 Hz probe tone), backtracked from the dominant local tone peak with a fixed amplitude threshold of 60
capture.calibrationBasis: the co-captured physical pad-impact transient is median-aligned seven 240 fps frames after the visible LED edge at absolute-sample thresholds 100, 120, and 150; subtract only six frames (25 ms), retaining one full capture frame as conservative A/V and marker quantization uncertainty
